notes: found by VID, PID and the exact USB product name "JadeAudio JA11" (findDevice), so the 1.5 list of DeviceTarget.find stays as it was

the tested unit is a retail FiiO JadeAudio JA11 (chip KT02H20) on FiiO's firmware V2.2: bcdDevice 0x0200 (the USB version shows 2.20 on Android); one HID interface (2) with reports 0x01 (consumer), 0x4B (10 bytes, the KT Micro registers: never written by this record), 0x54 (the bootloader unlock: never sent) and 0x02 (20 data bytes, the FiiO frame protocol); Android saw interrupt IN 0x83 and OUT 0x03

read only from the Mac on 11.11.2026 (run:2026-11-11-fiio-ja11-01-mac, backup-read.txt): slot 0x16 = 4 (Close EQ, the factory state: EQ off), band count 0x18 = 5, preamp (master gain) 0x17 = 0, five PEAK bands at 0 dB, Q register 70, at 1000/2000/5000/8000/10000 Hz, sample rate 0x09 = 7, firmware 0x0B = two data bytes 02 14, volume 0x02 = 60, mic 0x12 = 1, UAC 0x20 = 1; 0x1A (EQ switch) and 0x30 (names) get no reply

FiiO Control 4.6.2 config for this model and firmware (sc_config_default.db, device_type 109, command builder 61442 KT02H2X, run:2026-11-11-fiio-ja11-01-mac/fiio-control-ja11-2.20.json): PEQ 5 bands, filterList PEAK / LOW_SHELF / HIGH_SHELF (0 1 2), gain -12..+12 in 0.1 dB, master gain (command 0x17), presets 0 Vocal, 1 Classic, 2 Bass, 3 USER1 (the only custom one), 4 Close EQ; no names, no EQ switch; deviceCommandInterval 200 ms; settings mic_detect 0x12, uac_version 0x20, vol_output 0x02 (0-60, FiiO marks it adjust_reboot_tip), sample-rate read 0x09

devicePEQ (usbDeviceConfig.js, entry "JadeAudio JA11"): report 2, first writable slot 3, disabled preset 4, disconnectOnSave true, constraints peq5Band12dBFullShelves (5 bands, +-12 dB, Q 0.1-10, LS and HS, pregain): taken for the record; disconnectOnSave was confirmed on the unit (run 2026-11-11-fiio-ja11-02-mac)

FiiO frames on report 0x02 come with a CRC byte before the terminator: the replies' CRC is CRC-8/MAXIM over the bytes from the sequence byte to the last data byte, the 'bb 0b' header not included (12 of the 13 replies read on the Mac; the first, the slot reply, carries another value); FiioCodec's request CRC covers the header (the web app's capture), so pacing.checksum stays false: the frames go out as the Mac reader sent them, with sequence and CRC 0, and the unit answered them
the unit is told apart from the other FiiO DACs by its USB name; the 1.5 recognition list (find) is unchanged
never sent to this device: report 0x54 (bootloader unlock), FiiO command 0x21 (factory reset: reset-plan is refused), 0x1A (EQ switch: the unit does not answer) and 0x30 (names: no answer)

LOW_PASS (4) and HIGH_PASS (5) are offered above FiiO Control (which lists PEAK and the two shelves only): the unit took them and they play as pass filters (runs 2026-11-11-fiio-ja11-03, -04, -06 and -07), behind FiioJa11.PASS_FILTERS_VERIFIED (true, the Protocol Max's pattern); the high pass is steeper than a second-order RBJ one only deep in the stopband (HP 150 Hz: within 0.05 dB above 168 Hz, -0.27 dB at 10 dB attenuation, -0.67 at 16, -1.4 at 22, -5.9 at 34 dB)

BAND_PASS (3) is not offered: it was checked twice (BP 1000 Hz Q 1.4 in run 06, BP 2000 Hz Q 2 in run 07) and plays flat, not as a band pass; ALL_PASS (6) is not offered either: it plays flat, which cannot be told from an ignored type while BP is ignored, so it is not proven to do anything

measured (runs 2026-11-11-fiio-ja11-04 to -06): a shelf plays Q = register Q and a peak plays Q = register Q (shelfQScale and peakQScale 1.0), the preamp register offset is 0 (the preamp -6 dB played within 0.08 dB, +9 dB played); the DSP designs its biquads at about 192 kHz whatever the stream rate (against a 48 kHz model the peaks and shelves were 0.5-1 dB off above 6 kHz, against 192 kHz within 0.04 dB for peaks, 0.06 dB for a low pass at 4 kHz and 0.32 dB for the extreme shelves LS 80 Hz -12 dB and HS 10 kHz +9 dB, worst at 27 Hz); the volume register 0x02 moves the level 1.02 dB per step (59 played -1.02 dB against 60, at once, no reboot; back to 60 the same level within 0.01 dB; run 09)

the stock presets read like a USER slot: their band records parse with real values (Vocal: 40 Hz -1.9 dB, 180 Hz -4.9, 600 Hz +5.0, 2200 Hz +6.0, 7000 Hz -2.9), and Contour's select frame for 0, 1, 2 and 4 switches the preset, read back confirms, with no USB drop (run 2026-11-11-fiio-ja11-08-mac-presets)

measured on the unit 11.11.2026 (run:2026-11-11-fiio-ja11-02-mac): SAVE (0x19) takes it off USB for about 2.3 s and it comes back by itself (disconnectOnSave confirmed; the plan then selects USER1, writes, saves, and the registers read back after the return); a volume write (0x02) stays on the bus (about 1.07 s each); the in-line mic write (0x12) re-enumerates the unit (the mic input interface toggles), so that row says reconnectsAfterWrite: the value counts only after a read once the unit is back; the first slot reply after a long idle carried a stale CRC (c6, later reads 3e), so reply CRCs are never required

the stock presets (Vocal, Classic, Bass) and Close EQ are not offered: Contour writes and selects USER1 only (owner 11.11.2026, after a preset row was tried on the phone); a preset chosen with the select frame alone does not survive an unplug, the unit comes back on the last saved slot (run 2026-11-11-fiio-ja11-10-phone)

phone (Nothing, Android 15, run 2026-11-11-fiio-ja11-10-phone): every SAVE and every in-line mic write re-enumerates the unit, and Android asks for the USB permission again after each return; the read after the return then runs as on the Mac

reset.src: FiiO Control shows no factory reset for this model; command 0x21 is never sent to it

hwVolume.src: vendor HID volume 0x02 (0-60) is shown by FiiO Control; written and read back on the Mac (60 to 59 and back, about 1.1 s a write, no USB drop; 59 plays 1.02 dB below 60, run 2026-11-11-fiio-ja11-09-mac-volume); FiiO marks it adjust_reboot_tip, no reboot was seen

evidenceCaveats: No capture file: the identity 2972:0102 "JadeAudio JA11" was read on the owner's unit; devicePEQ's disconnectOnSave true was confirmed on it (SAVE takes it off USB for about 2.3 s)

tested.firmware: 2.20 (FiiO JA11 firmware V2.2, bcdDevice 0x0220; command 0x0B reads 02 14)
tested.contour: 1.6.6-perf on wip/devices-batch: Mac bench jar 960424b9, phone APK 87f87f2e (0e27c6c) on a Nothing A065, Android 15

rangesAccepted.note: Mac, run 2026-11-11-fiio-ja11-03-mac: 14 edge writes (20 and 20000 Hz, +-12 dB, Q 0.1 and 10, PK, LS, HS, LP, HP) and the preamp -12, -11.9, 0 and +12 dB written to USER1 and read back register for register after the unit's return from SAVE; all seven types of the table were taken, the record offers the five that play as drawn.

acoustic.note: Runs 04, 06 and 07 at -12 dBFS: PK mix 0.26 dB, shelf mix 0.39 dB, preamp -6 dB 0.08 dB, repeat 0.04 dB; shelf Q = register Q, preamp offset 0. The DSP designs at about 192 kHz whatever the stream: against that model PK +9 / -12 dB at Q 1 and 10 and Q 0.1 are within 0.04 dB, five bands 0.04 dB, LP 4 kHz 0.06 dB, the extreme shelves LS 80 Hz -12 dB and HS 10 kHz +9 dB 0.32 dB (at 27 Hz); preamp +9 dB plays. HP 60 and 150 Hz play as high passes, steeper than a second-order RBJ filter only deep in the stopband (HP 150: -0.27 dB at 10 dB attenuation, -0.67 at 16, -1.4 at 22, -5.9 at 34 dB). BP plays flat (checked twice) and AP is indistinguishable from an ignored type, so neither is offered.

persistence.note: Phone, run 2026-11-11-fiio-ja11-10-phone: a five-band edge profile (LS 20 Hz +12 dB Q 0.1, PK 20000 Hz -12 dB Q 10, HS 8000 Hz +6.7 dB Q 0.71, LP 20000 Hz, HP 20 Hz, preamp -12 dB) sent to USER1 read back VERIFIED after the SAVE return (about 2.3 s off USB); after an unplug and replug the cold read gave slot 3 and every band register and the preamp byte for byte as sent, volume and mic unchanged.

settings.note: Mac, run 2026-11-11-fiio-ja11-03-mac T14: volume 60 to 59 and back, read back, about 1.1 s a write and no USB drop (59 plays 1.02 dB below 60, run 09); in-line mic 0 to 1 and back, read back after each re-enumeration (about 2.4 s a write). Phone, run 2026-11-11-fiio-ja11-10-phone: volume 60 to 57 and back and mic 1 to 0 and back from the DAC page, each read back (the mic after the unit's return). USB audio (0x20) is read only.

tested.beyondVendor: FiiO Control offers PEAK, LOW_SHELF and HIGH_SHELF, its presets, volume and the in-line mic; Contour adds LOW_PASS and HIGH_PASS (they play as pass filters) and offers USER1, volume and mic; everything else equals FiiO Control (5 bands, +-12 dB, 20-20000 Hz, Q 0.1-10).
